remarks: Wonderful top floor condo is just totally renovated and move in. Amazing transformation to a luxury, light, bright modern residence with 2 generous bedrooms in New Canaan's most prime sought after location. Experience this uplifting home with completely new designer kitchen and bathroom, gleaming H/W floors, sparkling new windows, new doors, hardware, A/C's and more. 5 generous closets plus additional storage. Gas heat and hot water and included in the low monthly common charges. Reserved parking and private patio are right outside the door. Whether you are a first time purchaser or looking for a relaxed life style or even an investment opportunity, this perfectly located condo checks all the boxes. Situated across from dog friendly Mead Park with gorgeous pond for skating and fishing, baseball fields, tennis and pickleball courts, playground and outdoor cafe, the location is perfect. Also just steps away from New Canaan's vibrant town center with it's award winning restaurants, movie theater, shops, galleries and train to NYC. For in town living, this is a dream come true.
